remarks: Please SUBMIT OFFERS by Sunday, 1.12 at 5pm: Easy living in this charming Colonial situated perfectly by the new Darien Commons shopping center and the Noroton train station. Feel as if you are living in the city, with never needing to get in the car. This turn key home is charming and has many high end upgrades such as a brand new kitchen and a stunning bathroom remodel. The private lot is set back from the street, has been professionally landscaped with mature evergreens and is fenced in with a gate at the end of the long driveway. An attached garage is one of the many perks! This 4 bedroom home has flexible options for a work from home office, primary room expansion and much more. Don't miss the chance to make this gem Home.
